senses.gloss:
f. (-तिः)
1 A weapon.
2 A ray of the sun.
3 Flame.
E.
हि to go, or हन to kill, aff. क्तिन्; the form is irr.

m. (-तुः)
1 Cause, origin, motive.
2 The reason or argument for an inference or deduction.
E.
हि to go, Uṇādi aff. तुन्.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
1 Causal, instrumental.
2 Relating or belonging to the cause or motive.
m. (-कः)
An active cause. an instrument or agent.
E.
हेतु cause, and कन् added.

f. (-ता)
Causation, cause, causativeness, the abstract existence of cause or motive.
E.
हेतु cause, तल aff.; also हेतुत्व n. (-त्वं.)

mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्)
Having a cause, proceding from one, acknowledging one, &c.
E.
हेतु, and मतुप् aff.

m. (-दः)
Disputation.
E.
हेतु, and वाद dispute.

ind.
By reason or cause of.
E.
हेतु in the seventh case, used as a particle.

m. (-सः)
(In logic,) Fallacious semblance of reason or argument, assignment of proof or cause which can be shewn to be incorrect; various kinds are specified.
E.
हेतु, and आभास semblance.
